## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "unsure", "reason": "页面清楚描述了功能（地址生成场地底图，包含地块线、等高线、土壤、洪水区、湿地，支持 CAD/GIS 导出，并有图层命名规范），但没有给出数据来源、处理方式或技术细节，也没有确认开源仓库，因此很难判断其中是否有可复用的具体机制或权衡。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason accurately lists the features on the page: parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones, wetlands, CAD/GIS export, and layer naming. It is also correct that the page names no data sources and links no repo, even though the title says open-source. It states what is missing (data sources, technical details, a confirmed repo), which justifies the unsure decision.
